# MILE Ø v1.2 — Post-Run Feedback

Adds a **post-run feedback screen** immediately after saving a completed or missed run. It summarizes actual versus planned distance, pace, average HR, RPE, fatigue, pain, and recent logged sessions where available. Runners can **Keep my plan** or **Review future workouts** to see existing runner-approved adjustment proposals. No adjustments are made automatically.

**Important:** Feedback is generated by transparent JavaScript rules—not a connected generative AI model. It does not infer fitness from a single heart-rate reading or diagnose injuries. Adding real AI later requires a protected backend and consented handling of health data.

## Install
Back up training from the app first. Upload `index.html`, `sw.js`, `manifest.webmanifest`, and `icon.svg` to the root of the existing GitHub repo and commit. **Keep your already configured `config.js` unchanged.** Supabase database setup does not change.

## Quick test
Open an existing plan → Calendar → Log run. Enter actual mileage, pace, average HR, effort and fatigue. Save. You should see **MILE Ø / POST-RUN FEEDBACK**. Select **Keep my plan** or **Review future workouts**. Check that data persists after refresh.
